#+TITLE: ios/vendor · the Meta Wearables Device Access Toolkit, not committed

Put the toolkit SDK (Swift package or xcframework) and Meta's sample app here after registering on the Meta Wearables developer center (itlogs.food#1). The folder is gitignored so the SDK license is respected and so Claude Code reads the real API from source instead of guessing names. Then point =ios/project.yml= at the package and replace =GlassesSource= in =Sources/ItlogsFood/FrameSource.swift=.
